basics.name: Dakota Heim
basics.label: Senior Developer
basics.summary: Senior developer with 6+ years building production web applications, APIs, and cloud-ready systems for enterprise and global restaurant brands. Deep in Vue, React and TypeScript on the front end, with Node.js and Go services, PostgreSQL, and Redis behind them. Leads cross-functional initiatives, owns Docker-based CI/CD, and mentors developers through code reviews and pairing. Partners with client teams on high-visibility systems and releases for global restaurant brands, from pricing integration through production launch. Uses AI-assisted development tools daily and has shipped AI-driven data tooling to production.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
highlights: Architect a next-generation platform built on a rules-engine-driven JSON state model that powers dynamic web applications for all client brands.
Added Redis caching to a high-traffic Go pricing API receiving requests from ~15,000 devices every 15 minutes allowing 1k calls per minute to the cache DB.
Built AI-driven tooling that converts image data into structured datasets feeding internal systems, replacing hundreds of manual work.
Lead cross-functional initiatives across engineering and DevOps teams of 5-10 people in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Raised deployment reliability with Docker-based CI/CD workflows and feature-flag rollouts, removing human error.

positions.title: Intermediate Software Developer
highlights: Designed custom Docker CI/CD pipelines that automated complex build and deployment workflows, cutting manual build times drastically.
Built internal QA tooling that simulates API and WebSocket traffic, giving the team reliable, repeatable test environments.
Mentored 5-10 developers through code reviews, pair programming, and Agile ceremonies.
Established documentation standards that shortened new-developer on-boarding from 4 weeks to 2 weeks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Delivered enterprise banking features inside JPMorgan's internal application framework.
Helped decompose monolithic applications into modular services and APIs.
Built React proof-of-concept apps that supported the modernization of the chase.com frontend architecture.

positions.title: Software Developer
highlights: Built pricing-integration APIs enabling real-time menu and price updates for global restaurant brands across many locations.
Developed greenfield applications and supported high-availability production systems.
Coordinated releases across high-visibility client repositories.
